proposed_rules.trigger: A [3x1] row of short labeled items directly under a template-detail hero, where each label names a page of the template app (e.g. 'Invoices Page', 'Job Scheduling Page').
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a single 'template preview tabs' block (one row per tab/screenshot) rather than a generic marketing card grid.
proposed_rules.rationale: These items are likely navigational previews tied to one screenshot viewer, not standalone marketing cards. Rejected alternative: treating it as a plain repeating-cards-are-one-block card grid, which would lose the tab/viewer semantics and imply static duplicate cards instead of a single interactive component; needs human confirmation on whether interactivity should be preserved in EDS or flattened to a static image gallery.
